text: Dad can we go through the numbers tonight? Gas bill came and the electricity one is higher than last month
Tonight is fine. I have the folder from the kitchen drawer. Which bill first?
Gas. Then the water. The form from the pharmacy too, the reimbursement one. You still need me to look at that?
Yes. I filled in the first page but I am not sure about the box for the prescription number. It is on the receipt, I think.
Send me a photo of the receipt
[photo: pharmacy receipt]
Ok the number is the one at the top, not the one under the barcode. The barcode one is the transaction id
Ah. I thought it was the other one. Thank you.
Gas is 214 zł this month vs 168 last month. Is that the new tariff or did you have the heating on more
The heating was on more in the cold week. But the new tariff started in October, I read the letter. I did not check it against the bill.
Ok so part is tariff part is you. The electricity I cant explain yet
Electricity I will look at tomorrow after the shop. Today was a long day. We had a delivery come in late and I had to count the stock twice.
Wait tomorrow? I thought we were doing all of it tonight
I have the folder here. Give me ten minutes to find the electricity letter.
Found it. Tell me which months you need and I will read them out.
Just read me the kWh for the last two months
September 412. October 471. The rate line says 0.89 this month.
Ok thats the rate going up. 471 vs 412 is +59 kwh, prob the heater in the bedroom. Did you run it
Some evenings. Your mother used to say it was too warm. I did not want to sit in the cold.
Its fine dad. Just means we split it differently
Ill make a sheet tomorrow and send it to you
Good. Send it to my email too. I do not read the messages on the phone well at night.
Sheet is in your email. Gas: about 30 of the 46 extra is the tariff, the rest is the cold week
Good. I will read it at the shop
Water is flat, 38 zł same as last month. Nothing to fix there
Ok
The form. Do I post it or send it to the fund by email?
Scan it and email it. Keep the paper. Send me page 2 when its done
[photo: form page 2]
Looks right. Signature box is still empty, sign it before you scan
Signed. Sent it
The electricity letter says the reading is estimated. I think nobody came to read the meter
Estimated? So the 471 might be wrong
Maybe. I took a photo of the meter this afternoon
[photo: electricity meter]
Meter says 38217. Last real reading was 37746 in October. 38217 - 37746 = 471. So the bill is right, they just used the date on it
So nothing is wrong
Nothing wrong. The heater is the reason
I will turn it down
Mrs Wiśniewska came in with her husband's old prescription. She forgot the card. I told her to bring it tomorrow. She was upset
That's annoying. Did she get anything
Half. I gave her the cream we had in stock. The rest tomorrow
You ok? Sounded like a long one
Tired. Feet hurt from standing. Nothing new
Get some sleep. Send me the bank reference for the gas payment when you do it
Paid gas. Confirmation is in the email
Got the confirmation. Adding it to the sheet
Opening the shop. The cream came in yesterday so I have the rest for Mrs Wiśniewska
She came back. Brought the card this time
Good. Did you do the rest
Yes. She was calmer. She asked about you
Tell her hi from me
She knows you. She will ask again next week
Turned the bedroom heater down to 2. Cold in there but I will manage
Put a blanket on the chair. Cheaper
Did the water payment go through or is it still on the list
Still on the list. I will pay it when I am home
Ok. 38 like usual
Home. Folder is back in the drawer
Good
The fund sent the form back. They want a copy of the prescription too. I thought the receipt was enough
That's a different form. I'll check tomorrow, don't send anything yet
Ok
